fix.authenticodeLookup: Windows PowerShell 5.1 runs with a child-only environment whose single PSModulePath is the in-box System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\Modules (every inherited PSModulePath spelling removed), imports the in-box Security and Utility manifests by absolute path, and sets ErrorActionPreference Stop. The parent process.env, user and machine environment, registry and installs are not changed.
